fixtures.title: Cedar restaurant booking specification
fixtures.text:
Section 1: Cedar restaurant booking specification.
Cedar prevents double bookings using atomic table allocation. Holds expire after 5 minutes. Staff must confirm reservations; SMS failure must not cancel a confirmed booking.
Procedure 1: record the operator, timestamp, action, outcome, and reason for any exception. The responsible reviewer checks section 1 before closing the record.
